title: Spinnet Plugin Storage Host Services
description: The inputs and results of the Plugin Storage Host Services, as of Plugin API Level 1. Plugin Storage is the Plugin's own key-value store of JSON values, kept between invocations and launches, which no other Plugin can reach and which needs no Capability. A key is a non-empty string of at most 128 characters. A value, as compact JSON with its slashes unescaped, is at most 512 KiB; a Plugin keeps at most 10 MiB, counting each key file as the key's JSON, a newline and the value's JSON; and the list of its keys, as JSON, is at most 512 KiB. A write over a limit stores nothing and fails with storage_limit_exceeded, which the script may catch; any other failure ends the invocation as host_service_failed. The schemas check shapes, not those sizes.

key.description: A non-empty string of at most 128 characters, counted as Unicode code points. Keys are exact: they differ in case or Unicode normalization as JavaScript strings do.

value.description: Any JSON value. null is no value: storing it removes the key, and reading a key with no value answers null.

get_storage_value.result.description: The value kept under the key, or null when there is none.

set_storage_value.input.description: The key and the value to keep under it, replacing what was there. Only that key's file is rewritten.

remove_storage_value.input.description: The key to forget. A key the Plugin does not keep is no error.

list_storage_keys.result.description: Every key the Plugin keeps, sorted, without their values.

clear_storage.result.description: Every key is forgotten, as Clear Stored Data in the Library does.
